items.html: *Adam HaRishon was created by the coupling of Zeir Anpin and Nukva, who rose up into the chamber of Aba ve Ima, and there they coupled face to face and bore Adam and Eve. We shall explain the matter of Adam HaRishon, how he expanded within these worlds. For the head of Adam HaRishon was then in the world of Beriah, which is now the place of Zeir Anpin of Atzilut. And his throat was in the first four of Yetzira, which is now the place of the Nukva of Atzilut. And you already know that the Nukva of Atzilut is called the Garden of Eden; hence only his throat was placed in the Garden of Eden, and from there downward, the rest of his body was outside the Garden of Eden, in this manner: his whole body was placed in the last six of Yetzira and the first four of Assiya, which are now the measure of the place of the whole world of Beriah.
